plain_statement.zh: 每个充分大的二倍区间都有许多含大量中央素数分解的偶数，同时排除有界移位上的所有小素数见证
plain_statement.en: Many even targets with many central prime pairs in every sufficiently large dyadic interval exclude all bounded prime witnesses on a fixed window

brief.en: Fix the prime bound B and shift window H. The unbounded conclusion allows any prescribed number K of distinct unequal prime pairs. Quantitatively, for all sufficiently large X, at least X/(C log² X) even targets in [X,2X] each have at least X/(C log² X) distinct unordered central representations, with both primes between n/3 and 2n/3. For every such target and every d≤H, no prime p≤B gives a prime complement in either n−d or n+2−d. The constant and threshold may depend on B and H. Count pairs in two disjoint blocks of primes congruent to −1 modulo (B+H+2)! using the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions. A double count gives many large fibers.
brief.zh: 固定小素数上界 B 与移位窗 H。无界结论允许预先指定任意多种不等素数无序分解。定量地，每个充分大的 [X,2X] 都有至少 X/(C log² X) 个偶数 n，各自有至少 X/(C log² X) 种中央素数分解，两个加数都在 [n/3,2n/3] 内。对这些 n 和每个 d≤H，两侧 n−d 和 n+2−d 都不能用任何 p≤B 的素数配对。常数和起点可依赖 B、H。用等差数列素数定理在模 (B+H+2)! 的 −1 类取两组素数，并按和的原像大小作双重计数。
